purpose: Correctness and deterministic endurance; elapsed times are not a performance benchmark.
method: Three starts × three deliberate strategies × two seeds, each 365 complete days; one 730-day career stress case.
All choices use the public resolver. No resources, skills, clock or save-state setup patches.
Every action checks strict state validity, monotonic time, input immutability and whole-state deterministic shadow replay.
Shadow replay exports/imports every 37 turns; every checkpoint additionally round-trips the complete compact save.
Every resolved delayed systemic result is retried and must reject with the exact same state reference.
Maintenance and strategic counts classify public action IDs, not physical UI gestures; autonomous NPC contacts/offers/report arrivals are distinct counters.
Elapsed times are correctness runtimes, not serial performance measurements.
limitations: Scripted deliberate policies are not human playtests or proof of optimal economic balance.
The restart policies retain principal debt despite large bank balances; no automatic full repayment is assumed.
Fixed-seed finite runs cannot prove absence of every possible input/history bug.
Browser, payload, paired performance, full-repository CI and production release are separate gates.
